Maximum Profit with K Transactions

You are a high-frequency trading AI operating on the galactic stock market. Over N trading cycles, the price of a commodity follows a given sequence. You are permitted to make at most K transactions (each transaction is a complete buy-then-sell cycle, and you may not hold more than one unit at a time).

Given an array of N daily prices and an integer K, determine the maximum profit achievable.
explanation: Solution uses a space-optimized DP. Define dp[t][d] as the max profit using at most t transactions up to day d. The recurrence is: dp[t][d] = max(dp[t][d-1], prices[d] + max_prev) where max_prev tracks the best value of (dp[t-1][prev_day] - prices[prev_day]) seen so far. If k >= n/2, we can perform unlimited transactions, simplifying to a greedy sum of all positive differences. Time Complexity: O(K*N).
